name: Driver Form
author: msyeett
description: AI drivers have a weekend form: some are flying, others drift off the pace and make mistakes. Offline only. To see who is in form, turn on the toasts and Messages in ADDON SETTINGS. They are off by default.

options.label: Form strength
options.description: How big a driver's form is. Off is the normal AI. Subtle is about 0.8 s a lap either way, Normal 1.5, Wild 2.2, Chaos 3.5.

options.label: In form / Out of form toasts
options.description: After the first lap, name the drivers who are in form and out of form. Off by default.

options.label: Bad patches and mistakes
options.description: Drivers sometimes lose time for a while, make a sudden mistake, or find some pace, depending on their form.

options.label: Messages: Practice
options.description: How often a notification may appear in practice: mistakes, drivers struggling or on a charge, big position changes and pit stops. Low is about once a minute, Medium every 30 seconds, High every 15, Ultra as often as possible.

options.label: Messages: Qualifying
options.description: How often a notification may appear in qualifying: mistakes, drivers struggling or on a charge, big position changes and pit stops. Low is about once a minute, Medium every 30 seconds, High every 15, Ultra as often as possible.

options.label: Messages: Race
options.description: How often a notification may appear in race: mistakes, drivers struggling or on a charge, big position changes and pit stops. Low is about once a minute, Medium every 30 seconds, High every 15, Ultra as often as possible.

options.label: Show mistakes
options.description: "MISTAKE" toasts. Needs a Messages setting above None.

options.label: Show struggling
options.description: "STRUGGLING" toasts. Needs a Messages setting above None.

options.label: Show on a charge
options.description: "ON A CHARGE" toasts. Needs a Messages setting above None.

options.label: Show place changes
options.description: "UP" and "DOWN" PLACES toasts. Needs a Messages setting above None.

options.label: Show pit stops
options.description: "IN THE PITS" toasts. Needs a Messages setting above None.
